answer: Problem: cheap clones spam peer panels until one operator owns the quorum. Mechanism: each join posts a 32-byte beacon salt; peers issue a 90s horizon challenge ciphertext under the joiner's pubkey; the joiner must return a cipher plaintext plus HMAC of (salt||epoch||nonce) within that window. Cost: ~0.8 POA bond locked 3 epochs plus one ECDSA round-trip (~40ms). Verification: any peer recomputes HMAC and checks latency; mismatch or timeout burns 0.2 POA. Failure: if >2 timeouts in 5 joins, pubkey enters 24h quarantine and loses grading seats until a clean beacon pass.
